caption:
OFFLINE MODEL | Serial-calibrated host-service costs. Rule forms are assessed after existing matrix results.
No label refit. The signed bottleneck score compresses static costs and known controlled output,not one direct online observable.
Natural EOS,C3 packing and decode-safe online admission remain unvalidated. No serving-speedup claim.

formulas.load_blend_at_0_5: Use each action bottleneck demand when lambda*max(P,D)>=0.5. Else use serial sum.

scope: The serial-calibrated model is not refit to winner labels. Calibration and matrix tokenized prompts/contexts are disjoint. The rule forms are assessed after earlier matrix results,so this is not a blind prospective rule confirmation. The0.5 blend threshold is not tuned. Preserve its failures. One score compresses calibrated host-service estimates and known controlled output. It is not one directly measured online state. Natural EOS duration is not known at admission. C3 continuous packing,KV state and active-decode safety are not modeled. Ties have no winner label. Invalid safety cells do not enter valid regret. Pointwise labels have no multiplicity adjustment. Bottleneck classification accuracy is not a serving speedup or a proof that serial cost causes queue delay.
